historical_reviews.deepseek: The literal item label is not an established SDR identifier, and one truncated local listing cannot prove every CX7 adapter or port across both access paths.

historical_reviews.v3_1: A system can contain multiple ConnectX-7 adapters and ports with different link state and thermal exposure. A bare `CX7` match must be joined to PCIe identity, physical slot and port before a reading can be evaluated or duplicates distinguished.

original_test_intent: Validate all approved CX7 adapter and port sensor records in SDR and Sensor views through verified IB and OOB paths against the platform specification.
original_method: Inventory CX7 devices by stable PCIe/serial/slot/port identity, map each to canonical BMC records, collect complete protected SDR and Sensor outputs through same-target IB/OOB paths, normalize identity/association/reading/unit/status/threshold/freshness/link state and compare per device without changing NIC or BMC state.
manual_activity: The owner/vendor supplies the CX7 slot/adapter/port inventory, canonical sensor mapping, SPEC and link-state rules; the operator resolves ambiguous devices or readings and sets the verdict.
required_inputs: Canonical SDR and Sensor record map
safety_requirements: Never change NIC link, firmware, thresholds, events or fan state
Do not accept substring match as device identity
Do not truncate output before completeness checks
Stop on cross-device or path ambiguity
Never retry automatically to hide stale or divergent values
agent_execution_scope: Collect complete SDR and Sensor views on both paths
Normalize and compare readings with SPEC/link state
Verify no NIC or BMC mutation
Archive evidence and report without verdict
engineer_actions: Review missing, duplicate, stale or divergent records

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It queries a guessed title string through insecure SSH, truncates output and omits OOB and Sensor-list coverage, so it cannot establish device/port identity or satisfy the source criteria.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected complete `sdr elist` and `sensor list` collection through verified IB/OOB paths, then join canonical CX7 records to the approved slot/adapter/port inventory before comparison.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The read-only four-view scope and 3/3-minute estimate are preserved; unsafe transport, guessed identity and truncation are removed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Produce one row per CX7 sensor with PCIe/serial/slot/port identity, link state, SDR entity, live Sensor record, four-path values, freshness and SPEC disposition.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds stable hardware correlation, complete evidence and link-state semantics before applying text filters.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A CX7 grep cannot prove all adapters and ports are represented exactly once or explain expected unavailable values on inactive ports.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Firmware aliases may omit CX7 or aggregate multiple ports; only an approved inventory-to-sensor map can distinguish valid aggregation from missing coverage.

project_override_considerations: The Project must define whether the target includes every CX7 adapter, per-port sensors or only device-level thermal/health sensors, plus how link-down ports are judged. BF3 row 1665 remains a separate device family.
expected_evidence: Target identity, firmware and CX7 adapter/port inventory
Canonical sensor map and SPEC version
Complete redacted SDR and Sensor outputs from IB/OOB
Per-device/port normalized four-way comparison with link/freshness state

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, procedure filters and criteria consistently target CX7 sensor validation. Missing topology, canonical mapping and SPEC are execution prerequisites rather than competing source objectives.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The CX7 inventory, mapping and SPEC are obtainable project inputs. Execution reports BLOCKED if stable device identity or complete same-target evidence remains unavailable.

review_improvement: Prevents one generic text match from passing the wrong CX7 adapter or port and makes link-state-dependent readings auditable without changing the NIC.
independent_technical_reasoning: CX7 labels can identify a device family while the acceptance unit may be an adapter, port or thermal channel. Since identical models can coexist, sensor names alone are not unique. Stable PCIe/serial/slot correlation is required, and link state must be captured because inactive ports can legitimately change availability or thermal behavior without making the device sensor defective.
